Who writes this

Erika Christiansen, a licensed Colorado commercial real estate broker, and Steve Christiansen, MD, a practicing retina specialist and practice owner. Equal partners, investing in real estate since 2009. No ghostwriters, no content team.

Nothing here is legal, tax, accounting, financing, or investment advice. Bring your attorney and accountant to anything you sign, including anything from us.

Medre. The lease that ends in ownership.

MedRe Partners, LLC. A physician ownership platform. We buy the building, your practice leases it at fair market rent plus a small premium, and an exclusive purchase option lets you buy in any year from 5 through 10, at appraised fair market value plus a purchase premium that declines over time. Founded by a commercial real estate broker and a practicing physician.
